# Lead Lab mechanisms
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

These are Laravel mechanisms: routes and middleware control entry; controllers, Eloquent models, jobs, and scheduled commands implement the product rules. This page describes the load-bearing access, content, and reminder paths. `application/source/bootstrap/app.php:12-37`, `application/source/routes/web.php:24-56`, `application/source/routes/console.php:7-9`

## Access and registration

Self-registration creates a participant account with inactive, pending access and records an Activity Log entry. Active administrators receive a queued registration notification. `application/source/app/Actions/Fortify/CreateNewUser.php:25-60`

Every protected portal route passes through `auth` and `active`; administrator actions also pass through `admin`. Pending users are directed to review status, while inactive or revoked users are logged out. `application/source/routes/web.php:24-56`, `application/source/app/Http/Middleware/EnsureActiveUser.php:12-29`

## Sessions, resources, and Q&A

Administrators create a session as a draft, validate its fields and optional resource, then publish, unpublish, archive, or restore it. `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:79-109`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:154-195`

Resources are written to `lead-lab/resources` on Laravel's local disk. The download controller then checks both session visibility and file existence before returning a download. `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:237-251`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/LearningResourceController.php:12-27`

Q&A is limited to visible sessions. Authors can manage their own questions and answers; administrators can manage all content. Session and parent relationships are checked before updates or deletes. `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/SessionQnaController.php:34-70`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/SessionQnaController.php:161-190`

## Calendar reminders

The scheduler invokes `calendar:send-reminders` once a minute without overlap. The command finds due events, resolves currently eligible recipients, creates or reuses a delivery record, and dispatches a queue job. `application/source/routes/console.php:7-9`, `application/source/app/Console/Commands/DispatchCalendarEventReminders.php:8-20`, `application/source/app/Services/CalendarEventReminderService.php:15-98`

The job fails closed for disabled, changed, elapsed, or no-longer-eligible deliveries. It sends only to active, verified participants or administrators; it records sent or failed outcomes. `application/source/app/Jobs/SendCalendarEventReminder.php:25-90`

The runtime still needs a dependable mail transport, persistent queue worker, and scheduler service. Those are operating dependencies, not properties supplied by this source tree. `application/ops/calendar-event-reminders.md:6-13`
